payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate over hand cards, check if rank or suit matches table card, output YES immediately on first match, else NO.
payload.rationale: The solution performs a linear search over 5 cards, checking a condition. No recursion, backtracking, bitmask, graph traversal, or permutation enumeration. Among given subtypes, 'search_backtracking' is the most generic complete search label, though it does not exhibit true backtracking.
